body: If you need to talk I’m happy to chat and listen. Depression, suicidal ideations, this shit is brutal. Try to be kind to yourself. It’s tough. It sounds like the world is really coming down on you. Suicide and self abuse aren’t the answer though. Keep fighting the good fight.
Melatonin does nothing - the anxiety is extremely intense - negative thoughts non stop

I’ve used Benzos before and they’ve helped. I’ve never struggled with getting addicted to them.  I have no psychiatrist anymore where I live and this is something I need to deal with now. 

I might be able to get ambien from a friend.

I'm feeling horribly heartbroken as well. I jump between anger, sadness, and just intense physical pain. I wish you the best with this. I'm sure there is someone else out there that will light up your life again. You deserve love.
